title: Schedule logout with systemd-run like reboot and shutdown

workflow: Opus full review, Sol boundary hunter, Opus self-check of the draft, editorial check, batch gates

leads.summary: A clean merge with open #11151 makes the combined power test fail on logout
leads.consequence: #11151 changes the shared failure loop to require two systemd-run calls (user and system manager) for reboot/shutdown. This PR adds logout to that loop, but logout rightly makes only its single user-manager attempt, exits 1, and leaves OSD/windows untouched. The two-sided file merge has no conflict markers, yet the fixture reports 'not ok - logout leaves state and windows alone when scheduling fails'. Adjust the count by action or split the loop before merging both PRs. This is a test/merge regression, not evidence that production logout attempted an unintended fallback.
leads.triage: already in Opus final (F8); published in collapsed block

leads.summary: Two open OSD-stubbing PRs conflict with the expanded test fixture
leads.consequence: #12575 and #7216 each edit the same mock list and OSD expected lines as this PR. Three-way merge of the actual current heads against their own common ancestors leaves conflict markers (#12575 lines 20-27, #7216 lines 20-27 and 56-66 in the saved merged results). #7216 additionally changes stub logging to tab-delimited arguments, so retaining that version without updating this PR's logout expected lines causes fixture failure. Resolve by preserving the head's logout, uwsm/systemctl stubs and OSD assertions, and choosing one consistent log format. The overlapping OSD behavior is already implemented here, so these are reconciliation conflicts, not separate missing OSD functionality.
leads.triage: already in Opus final; covered by F8 status

leads.summary: Open #13076 rewrites the shared power test, requiring manual preservation of logout checks
leads.consequence: #13076 changes the shutdown production script to an inhibited worker and replaces the power-test assertions and mocks around the exact section that this PR uses for logout. An independent merge of the test produces conflict markers at lines 24-42 and 89-163 of merged/13076-result.sh. Taking #13076's side wholesale would discard this PR's successful scheduling/OSD/logout and failure-order tests, while taking this PR's side wholesale would fail to exercise #13076's new shutdown worker. Retain both sets of assertions and mocks when resolving; this is a confirmed text conflict, not a claim about which behavior GitHub would choose.
leads.triage: already in Opus final; covered by F8 status

leads.summary: CLI executable-mode fixture does not include logout despite a recent mode regression
leads.consequence: The CLI suite names reboot in its explicit executable-binary check but not logout, and its general metadata loop scans only executable files. Removing logout's executable bit again therefore makes the command disappear from bin/omarchy discovery and `omarchy logout --help` without failing `test/cli` (isolated mutant test exit 0). The changed system-power test DOES fail on this mutant with Permission denied, so the aggregate suite has coverage today. Add omarchy-system-logout to test/cli's explicit executable list and a safe logout --help/JSON route check as a direct guard for the CLI behavior that failed in the prior revision.
leads.triage: factual, verified by coordinator (test/cli:592); pre-existing, not introduced by PR, power test catches it; not published

limits: No live logout or access to host user manager was attempted; the source-only systemd-run interaction was checked against upstream v258 and uwsm v0.26.7, not a verified local installed systemd version. The sandbox mock does not execute queued uwsm stop; it verifies scheduling command arguments/order, not session termination.

comment:
## Automated AI review

> **Community review:** Independent automated community review, unaffiliated with the Omarchy team, intended to help prepare PRs for their review.

**Outcome:** No defects found.

Follow-up to the [second review](https://github.com/omacom/omarchy/pull/12254#issuecomment-5860990841) and the [author reply](https://github.com/omacom/omarchy/pull/12254#issuecomment-5864087479), checked at `ee3b1684`. It restores mode 100755 on both files without changing their content, and the reply's claims check out.

| Earlier point | Status |
|---|---|
| Logout script not executable | Resolved |
| #12233 linked as closed | Resolved |
| Power test passes | Holds again |
| Scheduling, wording, comment, stubs | Unchanged |
| #11151, #12575, #7216, #13076 | Unchanged: the #11151 combined test still fails on logout; #7216 now labeled `ready` |

#10353, #7501 and #7434 also conflict in the logout script (below).

<details><summary>Verified</summary>

- `git diff --raw 0056062e ee3b1684`: both files 100644 to 100755, same blobs (`a88f206e`, `29bbe062`). The PR no longer changes any mode relative to the base.
- `bash test/shell.d/system-power-test.sh` exits 0 with six `ok` lines. It still fails with the base `nohup` logout script and with a copy without `|| exit 1`.
- `omarchy logout --help` and `omarchy system logout --help` print the logout help; `omarchy system --help` lists `omarchy system logout`.
- `closingIssuesReferences` is empty.
- `quattro` moved from `3faafba` to `b421b1b4` without touching `bin/omarchy`, the power scripts, the power test or `test/shell`. The trial merge has no conflicts and the test passes on it.
</details>

<details><summary>Reproducer (passes at ee3b1684)</summary>

Checks at ee3b1684. `git ls-tree` ran on a plain clone. The test and help commands ran in an isolated sandbox on a read-only snapshot of the committed tree, with `systemd-run`, `uwsm`, `systemctl` and `loginctl` shadowed by logging stubs that exit 1 (none was called):

```sh
git ls-tree ee3b1684 bin/omarchy-system-logout test/shell.d/system-power-test.sh
bash test/shell.d/system-power-test.sh; echo "exit=$?"
bin/omarchy logout --help; echo "exit=$?"
```

Actual output:

```text
100755 blob a88f206eac252533a789c5fc0f2b2afd36ee168a	bin/omarchy-system-logout
100755 blob 29bbe062ed6af4ce6d3a1a875006ff7101daaede	test/shell.d/system-power-test.sh

ok - reboot runs after being scheduled outside the terminal scope
ok - shutdown runs after being scheduled outside the terminal scope
ok - logout runs after being scheduled outside the terminal scope
ok - reboot leaves state and windows alone when scheduling fails
ok - shutdown leaves state and windows alone when scheduling fails
ok - logout leaves state and windows alone when scheduling fails
exit=0

Usage:
  omarchy system logout

Log out after closing application windows

Examples:
  omarchy logout
  omarchy system logout

Aliases:
  omarchy logout

Binary:
  omarchy-system-logout
exit=0
```

`omarchy system logout --help` prints the same help (exit 0), and `omarchy system --help` lists `omarchy system logout`. At 0056062e the same commands give `Permission denied` then `not ok - logout runs after being scheduled outside the terminal scope`, and `Unknown Omarchy command: omarchy logout --help` (exit 127).

Negative controls at ee3b1684 (same test, only `bin/omarchy-system-logout` replaced, mode 755):
- base (`nohup`) logout script: fails with `not ok - logout runs after being scheduled outside the terminal scope`.
- current script without `|| exit 1`: fails with `not ok - logout aborts when scheduling fails`.

Trial merge of ee3b1684 into `quattro` b421b1b4: no conflicts, both files stay 100755, same six `ok` lines.
</details>

<details><summary>Related open PRs</summary>

- **#11151:** the merge has no textual conflict in either order, but the merged failure loop applies #11151's two-attempt count to logout, which makes one attempt, so the combined test fails. The same per-action fix is needed whichever PR lands second, and git does not flag it.
- **#7216** now carries the `ready` label. It conflicts in the stub loop and expected-log block and switches the mocks to tab-separated arguments, so if it lands first, the logout expected log needs that format.
- **#10353** conflicts in `bin/omarchy-system-logout` and the test. It adds `omarchy-session prepare-exit` before scheduling and `cancel-exit` on the reboot and shutdown failure paths. From source (not run), the new logout `|| exit 1` would need the same `cancel-exit` when its opt-in session restore is active, or a failed logout scheduling would leave automatic session saves off until the next login.
- **#7501** and **#7434** each add a line above the old `nohup` line, a small textual conflict.
- **#9520** changes reboot and shutdown to `--on-active="15s"` without touching logout, so logout would no longer use the same delay if it lands.
</details>

<details><summary>Reproducer (#11151 merged test)</summary>

Merge this PR (ee3b1684) and #11151 (901d9aa9) onto `quattro` (b421b1b4). The merge has no textual conflict, in either order, and gives the same tree. Then run the power test the way `test/shell` runs it. The test stubs `systemd-run`, `uwsm`, `systemctl` and `omarchy-osd`, so nothing is scheduled.

```sh
git fetch origin quattro pull/12254/head:pr-12254 pull/11151/head:pr-11151
git checkout --detach origin/quattro
git merge --no-edit pr-12254
git merge --no-edit pr-11151
bash test/shell.d/system-power-test.sh; echo "exit=$?"
```

Actual output (isolated sandbox, merged tree of b421b1b4 + ee3b1684 + 901d9aa9):

```text
ok - reboot runs after being scheduled outside the terminal scope
ok - shutdown runs after being scheduled outside the terminal scope
ok - logout runs after being scheduled outside the terminal scope
ok - reboot leaves state and windows alone when scheduling fails
ok - shutdown leaves state and windows alone when scheduling fails
systemd-run --user --collect --quiet --on-active=2s --timer-property=AccuracySec=100ms uwsm stop
not ok - logout leaves state and windows alone when scheduling fails
exit=1
```

The merged failure loop is `for action in reboot shutdown logout` with #11151's `!= 2` line count. Logout makes one `systemd-run --user` attempt, so its log has one line.
</details>
